articles.title: Flights halted at several major airports in Northeast due to tech problems - The Washington Post
articles.description: LaGuardia, JFK and Philadelphia appeared to be hardest hit.
articles.content:
Flights in and out of major airports in the Northeast were halted Monday afternoon after the sudden loss of air traffic communications, the Federal Aviation Administration said.
